thread:
Jon: Deploybot just blocked an image push for billing-api — ephemeral tag `deploy-ephemeral-abc123` collided in eu-west-1 ECR during the release window. Anyone seeing this?

deploybot: [automated] push rejected: tag collision detected. repo: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/billing-api:deploy-ephemeral-abc123; reason: tag already exists and provenance attestation mismatch. log id: db-3712345678

Maya: Yup, saw it. CI retried and ended up reusing the same ephemeral tag. Those are supposed to be single-use. We have ~25m left in the window — want to avoid halting the canary.

Kevin: Can we republish under a fresh ephemeral tag or just pin to the digest and route the canary to the digest? Pinning to digest is safer for immediate progress.

Sara: +1 for pin to digest. Who can force-publish or apply an override?

Jon: I can retag the image by digest: e.g. `docker pull repo@sha256:abcdef... && docker tag repo@sha256:abcdef... repo:release-20260321-1 && docker push repo:release-20260321-1` — but note provenance guard may still block if attestation/timestamp isn't present.

Maya: Another option is to create an immutable release tag with a fresh attestation (cosign), but KMS in eu-west is slow right now. Short-term: digest alias override sounds fastest.

Kevin: Decision proposal: pin canary to the existing digest (sha256:abcdef...) and update releasebot routing to use digest alias for the canary traffic. Then schedule a republish job from CI to create a proper release tag with attestation after the window. Sara, can you approve?

Sara: Approved. Please also add a short note to release notes explaining the emergency pin and that we'll republish later. File an infra ticket to prevent ephemeral reuse.

Jon: Doing it now. Steps I'll run: 
1) Apply rollout override: `releasebot override set billing-api canary digest=sha256:abcdef... --reason "ephemeral tag collision"`
2) Kick republish job: `ci run publish-billing-api --tag release-20260321-1 --wait` (run after window)
3) Open infra bug: duplicate-ephemeral-tag-rejection

deploybot: [automated] rollout override applied for canary: digest=sha256:abcdef... by Jon

Maya: Verified canary traffic is still flowing to the pinned digest. :thumbsup:

Jon: Added note to the release PR and created infra ticket INFR-1293. Also added a one-liner to the change log: "Canary pinned to immutable digest due to ephemeral tag collision; will republish stable tag post-window."

Kevin: We should also add a CI guard to fail if it attempts to reuse an ephemeral tag value. Adding that to the infra ticket.

Sara: OK — no rollback, proceed with release 47 on schedule. Thanks everyone.

Jon: Closing thread after republish job completes and we confirm attestation on the stable tag.
